title: pft: An R package for reference values and interpretation of pulmonary function tests
description: An open-source R package for pulmonary function test (PFT) reference values and routine interpretation. Reference equations are drawn from the Global Lung Function Initiative family (GLI-2012 and GLI Global 2022 spirometry, GLI-2021 static lung volumes, and GLI-2017 diffusion capacity with the 2020 author correction). Interpretive primitives implement the ERS/ATS 2022 technical standard (Stanojevic et al. 2022) for pattern classification, severity grading, bronchodilator response, PRISm identification, and conditional-change z-scores, together with the GOLD 2026 spirometric airflow-limitation grade, the Graham et al. 2019 spirometry session grade computed from maneuvers already judged acceptable, hemoglobin correction, and the FEV1Q survival index. Pellegrino et al. 2005 legacy primitives are retained for cross-standard reclassification analyses. Guideline and reference-equation updates are introduced only in new versioned releases.
